title: Functorial quotient pages with representative differentials
statement: Let C be abelian [def-sp-abelian], and let F be the full category of finite decreasing filtered cochain complexes [def-sp-filtration]. For each U,p,q,r>=1 let hBZ give B_r<=Z_r [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], and write Q_r=coker(B_r to Z_r). For each U,r let D(U,r) be representative differential data [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential], whose representative equation is x to dx. There exist a functor S:F to cohomological spectral sequences starting at 1 [def-sp-spectral-sequence] and eZ:E_r^(p,q)(U) isomorphic to Q_r^(p,q)(U). For all source and target bidegrees i,j, d_S(i,j)eZ_j=eZ_i D(i,j). If t has step restrictions s, graded descent g, cycle restriction kz, and quotient descent k satisfying the step-inclusion, graded-projection, cycle-inclusion and boundary-projection squares, then S(t)_r eZ_V=eZ_U k. No graded-homology comparison, first-page connecting map or exact couple is asserted.

source.place: Tag 012K, Lemmas 12.24.2 and 12.24.4; parent realization steps 1 and 3; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/012K

proof.text: For each U and r use the concrete cokernel Q_r=Z_r/B_r. Its D differential is uniquely determined by its representative equation x to dx. Successor cycles map epically onto its kernel, and the preimage of the incoming boundaries is B_(r+1). Therefore the induced quotient isomorphism H(Q_r,D_r) to Q_(r+1) is normalized by the successor-cycle projection. Use these normalized isomorphisms, not arbitrary existential homology isomorphisms, to assemble the spectral sequences.

For t:U to V, choose its step restriction from the preservation property. Cancel the monic target step inclusion to prove uniqueness. Descend to the graded quotient by its cokernel property, restrict to graded cycles using the defining pullback/image formulas, and descend modulo boundaries. These are the unique maps in the four squares of the statement.

On an epic cover by cycle representatives, the two composites with the page differentials are induced by t d = d t; hence they coincide. The same successor-cycle equation proves commutation with the normalized homology comparisons. Thus the quotient maps give spectral-sequence morphisms. Cancel the epic boundary projections and monic cycle inclusions to prove identity and composition. Take eZ to be the identity comparison of the concrete cokernels (boundary containment proofs are proof-irrelevant). This gives hd and naturality for every displayed choice of the restriction and descent maps.
